description:
Looking at the code, I can see the bug clearly: The n-gram vectorization variables (`train_char_short`, `train_char_med`, etc.) are referenced in the `hstack()` call BEFORE they are defined, because the feature extraction code appears in the wrong order. The vectorization calls are placed AFTER the chi-squared feature selection block that tries to use them.

Let me fix this by reordering the code - moving the n-gram vectorization BEFORE the chi-squared feature selection block, and removing the duplicate code that exists later.
method: The pipeline includes: (1) feature engineering with stylometric features (character/word counts, punctuation ratios, readability scores, POS approximation, etc.), n-gram TF-IDF vectors (char and word), and punctuation sequence features, followed by chi-squared feature selection; (2) 3-fold cross-validation fine-tuning of microsoft/deberta-v3-large with gradient accumulation, cosine annealing warm restarts, and linear warmup; (3) XGBoost classifier trained on a combination of handcrafted features and DeBERTa embeddings; (4) multinomial logistic regression on chi2-selected n-gram features; (5) ensemble weight optimization via grid search on OOF validation log loss; and (6) final submission generation.
